# Cncf Opencompass Reviewer

Review opencompass using its official documentation and repository in the Training / Evaluation category. OpenCompass is an LLM evaluation platform, supporting a wide range of models (Llama3, Mistral, InternLM2,GPT-4,LLaMa2, Qwen,GLM, Claude, etc) over 100+ datasets

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
